Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 028. 展平多级双向链表

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/*
// Definition for a Node.
class Node {
public:
    int val;
    Node* prev;
    Node* next;
    Node* child;
};
*/

class Solution {
public:
    Node* flatten(Node* head) {
        flattenGetTail(head);
        return head;
    }

    Node* flattenGetTail(Node* head) {
        Node* cur = head;
        Node* tail = nullptr;

        while (cur) {
            Node* next = cur->next;
            if (cur->child) {
                Node* child = cur->child;
                Node* childTail = flattenGetTail(cur->child);

                cur->child = nullptr;
                cur->next = child;
                child->prev = cur;
                childTail->next = next;

                if (next)
                    next->prev = childTail;

                tail = childTail;
            } else {
                tail = cur;
            }

            cur = next;
        }

        return tail;
    }
};
